content: sam_hdr_parse (12 lines wrapper, but delegates to complex internal parsing): parses @HD, @SQ, @RG, @PG lines from SAM header text into the bam_hdr_t struct's internal data structures including target name/length arrays and hash tables. Used in HeaderView::from_bytes. A Rust replacement would parse the text into Rust-owned data structures (Vec of target names+lengths, HashMap for name→tid) and only construct a minimal C struct for FFI compatibility with remaining C functions.
